evidence: The formation of Ru nanoparticles was performed on a showerhead type thermal ALD system using 2,4-(dimethylpentadienyl)-(ethylcyclopentadienyl)Ru as the metal precursor and oxygen as a reactant at a substrate temperature of 250 /C176C. Ru deposition was repeated for 650 cycles, which corresponds to a Ru film thickness of ∼ 26 nm on a Si substrate.
